findings.title: Stats request that never answers leaves 'Loading stats…' forever with the old range's results shown
findings.expected: After changing From to 2026-07-01 and the request hanging, a timeout or error and a way to retry; old results not presented as current
findings.actual: After 13 s the page still shows 'Loading stats…' with the previous 1 Jan-31 Dec table and best plants under the new From date, with no error and no timeout
